_meta.notes: Keys are lowercased Latin binomials (matches lt-names-overrides.json convention). Values are canonical Lithuanian names per lt.wiki. Only includes entries with strong Wikipedia evidence — see .md for legit-alt, unverifiable, and false-positive entries.

genusTokenFixes._note: Systematic typos / wrong genus tokens to bulk-replace in any lithuanian field. Apply with caution — only as last-word or genus-token replacement, NOT as raw substring (some are common letter sequences).

falsePositives.reason: Wikipedia has dedicated article 'Gebenė lipikė' — current name is correct. Phase 1 expectedLastWord algorithm misfired because LT binomial puts genus first.
